threat_event: Fraudster changes a claimant's or repair shop's bank details by phone and redirects claim payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Knowledge-based verification only; two attempts in 2026 stopped by positive pay review
treatment_plan: Verification to contact data on file; hold on first payment after a change (GR-03)

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over policyholder portal accounts and changes payment methods
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA offered but optional for policyholders
treatment_plan: Step-up MFA for payment and contact changes

threat_event: Phished independent agency credentials are used to extract policyholder nonpublic information in bulk
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,400 agencies; MFA required but agency offboarding depends on agency notice
treatment_plan: Quarterly agency user attestation; anomaly alerts on quote and policy lookups

threat_event: Ransomware encrypts the claims platform during hurricane season
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Claims platform in provider A with warm standby; shared identity
existing_controls: Immutable backups; standby in provider B
treatment_plan: Isolated recovery account; annual catastrophe-season failover test

threat_event: An impostor obtains a surge adjuster account during a catastrophe and accesses claims
threat_source: Fraudster posing as an independent adjuster
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Surge onboarding of up to 1,500 adjusters in 72 hours relies on adjusting-firm rosters and knowledge questions
existing_controls: Accounts expire automatically; adjusters limited to assigned claims
treatment_plan: Pre-season identity proofing of rostered adjusters; activation only against verified rosters

threat_event: Commissioners in Alabama, South Carolina, or Tennessee are not notified within 72 hours of determining a cybersecurity event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix lacks commissioner rows (scenario gap 7)
existing_controls: Insurance chief compliance officer's state contact list

threat_event: Colocation outage halts workers' compensation claims and benefit payments beyond the 12-hour RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-I4 has no second site; rebuild estimated at 36 hours
existing_controls: Nightly backups to provider B; manual benefit payment list
treatment_plan: Recovery environment in provider B by 2027-06-30; replatform decision in 2027

threat_event: Claims fraud scoring model refers some groups of policyholders for investigation at unfair rates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Referral rates by geography not monitored; North Carolina adopted the NAIC AI bulletin
regulatory_driver: NAIC AI Model Bulletin (North Carolina Bulletin No. 24-B-19)
treatment_plan: Quarterly disparity monitoring; model documentation to the bulletin's program elements

threat_event: Photo-estimating vendor breach exposes claim photos and policyholder data
treatment_plan: Shorten vendor retention to 3 years at renewal

threat_event: Producers of record are not told that their clients were affected by an insurer cybersecurity event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No procedure for Model #668 sec. 6F notices
treatment_plan: Producer notice template and agency contact extract

threat_event: Workers' compensation claimant medical details are shared with employers beyond what they need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Adjusters forward clinic records to employer contacts by email
treatment_plan: Employer status template without diagnoses; DLP rule for medical terms to employer domains

threat_event: Unsupported components in the workers' compensation platform are exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two application servers on an operating system past vendor support
existing_controls: Network isolation in the colocation data center; EDR

threat_event: Insurer boards are not told the status of the holding company's services as a Third-Party Service Provider
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Annual board reports do not cover intercompany services
existing_controls: Annual written report to each insurer board
treatment_plan: Add a TPSP section to the 2027 reports (GR-06)

threat_event: Proposed homeowners pricing model using aerial imagery produces unfair outcomes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model proposed; data attributes not reviewed
regulatory_driver: NAIC AI Model Bulletin (North Carolina); state unfair discrimination laws
treatment_plan: No deployment until the Group AI council approves an impact assessment

threat_event: Claim files with nonpublic information are kept long after the retention schedule
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Retention schedule defined in 2019 but not enforced in SYS-I2
treatment_plan: Automated purge of closed claims past retention

threat_event: An adjuster with payment authority issues fraudulent claim payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payment authority up to $25,000 without second approval
treatment_plan: Second approval for payments to new payees

threat_event: Reinsurance and audit data sent by unencrypted email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No secure transfer for ad hoc data requests
treatment_plan: Accepted until the secure transfer portal is extended (TLS enforced with the top 5 reinsurers)

threat_event: Claims staff paste claim notes with medical details into the AI assistant and share outputs widely
treatment_plan: Labels on claim sites; usage guidance for claims staff (GR-10)
